drew helleson.note: Helleson (lower body) hopes to return at the end of Anaheim's upcoming road trip, per Zach Cavanagh of The Sporting Tribune on Wednesday.

troy terry.note: Terry (hip) was moved from the non-roster list to long-term injured reserve Wednesday, Zach Cavanagh of The Sporting Tribune reports.

charlie mcavoy.note: McAvoy logged an even-strength goal on three shots and four PIM in a game-high 28:35 of ice time during Sunday's 3-2 shootout win over the Capitals in preseason play.

jason zucker.note: Zucker (abdomen) participated in Tuesday's morning skate but is still a few weeks away from returning to game action, Matthew Fairburn of The Athletic reports.

alex lyon.note: Lyon (upper body) was spotted practicing at Tuesday's optional morning skate, per Matthew Fairburn of The Athletic.

conor timmins.note: Timmins (lower body) doesn't have a timeline for his return yet, according to Heather Engel of NHL.com on Tuesday.

topias leinonen.note: Leinonen (lower body) was placed on the injured non-roster list Monday.

jonathan huberdeau.note: Huberdeau (hip) was placed on injured reserve Monday, per Pat Steinberg of QR Calgary 770 AM.

seth jarvis.note: Jarvis (shoulder) was placed on the injured non-roster list Sunday.

connor bedard.note: Bedard (shoulder) was on the ice for Monday's practice session, Scott Powers of The Athletic reports.

logan oconnor.note: O'Connor (lower body) will not play Thursday in Calgary following the sudden passing of his father, Myles.

georgii merkulov.note: Merkulov (undisclosed) was put on non-roster injured reserve Monday.

matt duchene.note: The Stars placed Duchene (lower body) on long-term injured reserve Thursday, retroactive to Sept. 29.

marco kasper.note: Kasper (upper body) has been given a week-to-week timetable for return.

simon edvinsson.note: Edvinsson, who is a restricted free agent, has returned to Sweden to resume his training, per Andreas III Johnsson of Goteborgs-Posten on Wednesday.

carter bear.note: Bear (upper body) was placed on the injured non-roster list Monday.

zach hyman.note: Hyman (undisclosed) is expected to be out of action for two weeks, Oilers play-by-play announcer Jack Michaels reports Thursday.

alec regula.note: Regula (undisclosed) was designated for long-term injured reserve Thursday.

ryan nugent hopkins.note: The Oilers placed Nugent-Hopkins (lower body) on injured reserve Thursday.

matt savoie.note: Savoie (lower body) was shifted to long-term injured reserve Thursday.

frederik andersen.note: Andersen (knee) isn't expected back until "maybe" December, head coach Mike Babcock told NHL.com on Tuesday.

mattias janmark.note: Janmark (undisclosed) does not have a timetable for his return from injury.

aleksander barkov.note: Barkov (lower body) will be out for approximately 6-8 weeks, Jameson Olive of the Panthers' official site reports Tuesday.

jonah gadjovich.note: Gadjovich (upper body) is out indefinitely, the team announced Thursday.

jan jenik.note: Jenik (undisclosed) was placed on non-roster injured reserve by Los Angeles on Thursday, per Zach Dooley of LA Kings Insider.

kevin fiala.note: Fiala (lower leg fracture) is at least three weeks away from being ready to play, Zach Dooley of the Kings' official site reports Thursday.

olli maatta.note: Maatta (lower body) won't play Thursday versus the Lightning.

brock faber.note: Faber underwent a procedure to repair his fractured skull and is without a timetable to return, per Michael Russo of The Athletic.

filip gustavsson.note: Gustavsson (hip) was placed on injured reserve Monday, according to Dylan Loucks of The Hockey News.

ivan demidov.note: Demidov (lower body) was placed on injured reserve by the Canadiens on Tuesday, per the NHL media site.

kaiden guhle.note: Head coach Martin St. Louis said Monday that Guhle (groin) is getting close to being ready to play, Stu Cowan of The Montreal Gazette reports.

jonas siegenthaler.note: Siegenthaler (undisclosed) is improving and hasn't been ruled out against Vancouver on Saturday, Kristy Flannery of The Hockey News reports.

seamus casey.note: Casey will be out of action for 6-8 weeks after undergoing a knee procedure, Kristy Flannery of The Hockey News reports Friday.

johnathan kovacevic.note: Kovacevic (knee) will begin the 2026-27 regular season on the injured non-roster list, per Mike Morreale of NHL.com.

mathew barzal.note: Barzal (knee) might resume skating this weekend or early next week, Andrew Gross of Newsday reports Wednesday.

cameron crotty.note: Crotty (illness) won't play Thursday versus the Flyers, per TSN 1200 Ottawa.

artem zub.note: Zub, who has been recovering from a knee injury, was seen skating during Senators' morning skate Thursday, per Wayne Scanlan of Sportsnet.

andre burakovsky.note: Burakovsky (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Monday, according to Bruce Garrioch of Postmedia.

kurtis macdermid.note: MacDermid (upper body) was moved to the injured non-roster list Monday.

helge grans.note: Grans (lower body) was put on the injured non-roster list Monday.

justin brazeau.note: Brazeau (lower body) was placed on injured reserve by the Penguins on Sunday.

ryan graves.note: Graves (lower body) is out indefinitely and was placed on injured reserve Sunday.

alex barre boulet.note: Barre-Boulet (undisclosed) will begin the 2026-27 regular season on injured reserve, per Curtis Pashelka of The San Jose Mercury News.

quentin musty.note: Musty (upper body) was put on non-roster injured reserve Monday, according to Curtis Pashelka of The San Jose Mercury News.

jacob melanson.note: Melanson (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Saturday.

yanni gourde.note: Gourde (hip) was placed on the injured non-roster list Monday.

dakota joshua.note: Joshua (abdomen) has been moved from the non-roster list to long-term injured reserve, PuckPedia reports Wednesday.

rasmus sandin.note: Sandin (knee) will begin the 2026-27 regular season on the injured non-roster list.
